## Fix: resource costs are not coin prices
The old bare-price matcher recognized `Cost:` inside longer labels such as `Mana Cost:` and `Soulflow Cost:`. Bare prices now require a complete price field and reject resource units, stat glyphs, percentages, timers and other ambiguous suffixes. Mana, Soulflow, health and other resource costs keep their original text and formatting. Explicit coin amounts remain supported, including the coin part of mixed-resource purchase prices.

## Optional CustomScoreboard compatibility
Adds display-only compatibility with **meowdding/CustomScoreboard 1.12.11 for Minecraft 26.1.x**, tested using its unmodified published binary (Modrinth version `9ZQ8S1sQ`). Supports:
- Purse and Piggy elements with all four label/number arrangements.
- Label-free purse values in Chunked Stats; non-coin chunked stats remain unchanged.
- Uncustomized Hypixel Lines, retaining the 1.2.1 section-p formatting fix.

Conversion happens before widget sizing, so CustomScoreboard retains its own layout, alignment, background, actions and visibility settings. Coins to Money's sidebar toggle and existing display options apply. Money/cookies remain green; retained coin and gain text retain their styles. No balance API or server scoreboard data is modified. No standalone HUD is added.

CustomScoreboard and Kotlin are optional and are not bundled in this JAR. Install CustomScoreboard's own dependencies when using it. Other versions may change the integration methods; rounded/compact amounts are converted at their displayed precision.

## Verification
**177 unit tests passed**, with zero failures, errors or skipped tests. This includes 58 price/resource regressions and the earlier exact purse diagnostic. Real Fabric clients passed **120 rendering frames without the optional mods and 120 frames with CustomScoreboard installed**, checking its actual formatter, PurseElement, chunk suppliers, widget widths, green text, settings and unchanged raw balances. These use synthetic inputs, not a logged-in Hypixel playtest.

The attached JAR is the exact tested build artifact, not a rebuild. `SHA256SUMS` is included.

## Installation
Replace the old mod JAR with **coins-to-money-1.2.2.jar**, keeping only one version installed. Existing settings are retained; no configuration reset is needed.

Requires **Minecraft 26.1.2**, **Java 25**, **Fabric Loader 0.19.5+**, and **Fabric API 0.155.3+26.1.2**. Mod Menu is optional. **K** opens settings; **O** toggles conversion.
